scripts.dev: concurrently "node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run dev" "node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run build && node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix worker run cf-typegen
scripts.deploy:frontend: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run build && npx wrangler@3 pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name=clip
scripts.deploy: node "%npm_execpath%" --prefix frontend run build && npx wrangler@3 deploy --cwd worker && npx wrangler@3 pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name=clip
